commits.subject: Use schedule date for next wakeup
commits.body:
Use schedule date for next wakeup

Build scheduler default wake-up timestamps on the schedule game date rather than the current wall-clock date, so tomorrow lookahead wake-ups are future timestamps.

This prevents the scheduler from exiting immediately after day completion and being relaunched repeatedly by Restart=always.
